integrity: Analytical argument includes critical crossing transversality, Gaussian variation-diminishing mode count, critical fourth derivative and uniform endpoint Laplace estimates; 67 finite numerical diagnostics support but cannot prove global statements. No independent scientific audit.
limitations: Exact stationary law of a one-dimensional symmetric velocity-flipping harmonic particle with independent additive Brownian noise; no sampling or higher-dimensional assertion. Previously published convolution, implicit modal boundary, and leading inverse-logarithmic threshold are acknowledged, not rediscovered.
title: Sharp endpoint corrections to the thermal mode-transition curve of a harmonically trapped run-and-tumble particle
